prompts.prompt: Which health insurance for a freelancer?

issues: ℹ️ 1 prompt/engine pair(s) have fewer than 5 runs and get no verdict

issues.finding: AI answers state Assurly's pricing wrongly in 1 of 1 answers that state it (chatgpt 1/1).
issues.evidence: chatgpt, "Which health insurance for a freelancer?" run 1: "At Assurly, the Essential plan costs €45 per month."
issues.impact: Buyers who ask an AI assistant get a wrong fact about the brand, and engines repeat what their sources say.
issues.fix: State the fact plainly and early on grille tarifaire (one sentence, e.g. "Assurly starts at 39"), then correct your third-party profiles (Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, G2). Re-run the same prompts in a month.
issues.falsifiability: Wrong if the quoted sentence is about another product or an older plan; read the example before editing.
issues.leading_indicator: Wrong-answer rate for pricing on the same prompts, one month after the fix.

limits: Every run must be a fresh session (logged out or history off), with location and search mode noted. Personalised answers are not comparable.
Rates describe the prompts sampled, not every query. Write prompts the way users ask, across intents, and keep the set fixed between measurements.
The 95% interval is the margin of error of this sample. Engines or months whose intervals overlap show no demonstrated difference.
